items.title: Angola Talking Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: he learned me how to play a record he called 44 on a guitar

ctx.x: And another guy by the name of Ernest 44. Now, he learned me how to play a record he called 44 on a guitar. And I learned that piece, and I've been playing it ever since. That record has made me right amount of money since I've been playing it.
Who cut the record? Do you remember who made it?
